# Ultralytics YOLOv8-s-pose

Pose Estimation · `yolov8-s-pose_640x640` · DX-APP Python example

Pose Estimation model, evaluated on COCO Keypoints 2017.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO Keypoints 2017 · **License** AGPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![Ultralytics YOLOv8-s-pose output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov8s_pose
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/pose_estimation/yolov8_pose/yolov8-s-pose_640x640/yolov8-s-pose_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov8-s-pose_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_people.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov8-s-pose_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/yolov8-s-pose_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov8-s-pose_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_people.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 58.35 |
| Q-Lite | 57.44 (−0.91) |
| Q-Pro | 57.48 (−0.87) |

COCO Keypoints 2017 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
